name: Common cold
about: A mild viral infection of nose and throat. Usually settles by itself in 5–7 days.
homeCare: Rest and drink plenty of warm fluids
Steam inhalation and warm salt-water gargles
Eat light, home-cooked food

name: Viral fever / flu
about: Fever with body ache, usually caused by a virus. Most people recover in 3–5 days with rest.
homeCare: Rest, drink water, ORS and coconut water
Sponge with lukewarm water if the temperature is high
Take fever medicine only as advised by a doctor or as per the label
seeDoctorIf: Fever above 103°F or lasting more than 3 days
Rash, severe headache or pain behind the eyes (dengue is common in monsoon)
Child, pregnant woman or elderly person with fever

name: Sore throat
about: Throat inflammation, most often viral. Sometimes bacterial and then needs a doctor's treatment.
homeCare: Warm salt-water gargles
Warm tea with honey and ginger (not for babies under 1 year)
Avoid cold drinks and dust

name: Allergic cold / hay fever
about: Sneezing and watery nose or eyes triggered by dust, pollen or smoke. Often worse in mornings.
homeCare: Avoid dust, wash bedsheets weekly in hot water
Wear a mask in dusty places
Saline nasal rinse
seeDoctorIf: Symptoms every week for a month

name: Sinusitis
about: Blocked, inflamed sinuses causing pressure around the nose, forehead and cheeks.
homeCare: Steam inhalation twice a day
Warm compress on the face
Drink plenty of fluids

name: Cough / bronchitis
about: Irritated airways causing lingering cough, sometimes with phlegm.
homeCare: Warm fluids and honey (not for babies under 1 year)
Avoid smoke and dust
Rest

name: Asthma flare-up
about: Narrowed airways causing wheeze, cough and tight chest, often at night or with dust and cold air.
homeCare: Sit upright and stay calm
Use your prescribed inhaler as your doctor has told you
Stay away from smoke and dust
seeDoctorIf: Cannot speak in full sentences — this is an emergency

name: Acidity / GERD
about: Stomach acid moving up, causing burning in chest or throat, mostly after heavy or spicy meals.
homeCare: Eat small, light meals; avoid lying down right after eating
Cut down on spicy, oily food, tea and coffee
Raise the head of the bed slightly

name: Loose motions / food infection
about: Infection from contaminated food or water. Dehydration is the main danger.
homeCare: Sip ORS every few minutes
Eat banana, rice, curd, khichdi
Wash hands; drink boiled or filtered water
seeDoctorIf: Signs of dehydration: very dry mouth, little urine, dizziness
Diarrhea longer than 2 days, or any infant/elderly person with diarrhea

name: Constipation
about: Hard or infrequent stools, usually from low fibre and little water.
homeCare: More water, fruit, vegetables, whole grains
Walk daily
Do not strain for long

name: Urine infection (UTI)
about: Bacterial infection of the urine passage. Needs a urine test and usually antibiotics from a doctor.
homeCare: Drink plenty of water
Do not hold urine
Do not self-medicate with antibiotics
seeDoctorIf: Fever, back pain or blood in urine

name: Tension headache
about: Dull band-like headache from stress, poor sleep, long screen time or skipped meals.
homeCare: Drink water, eat on time, sleep 7–8 hours
Rest your eyes every 20 minutes of screen time
Gentle neck stretches
seeDoctorIf: Vomiting, vision changes or fever with headache

name: Migraine
about: Throbbing, often one-sided headache with nausea and sensitivity to light or sound.
homeCare: Rest in a dark, quiet room
Note triggers: sleep loss, hunger, strong smells
Keep a headache diary for the doctor

name: Pink eye (conjunctivitis)
about: Red, sticky or watery eyes. Viral and bacterial types spread easily.
homeCare: Wash hands often; do not share towels
Clean the eyes with clean, cooled boiled water
Avoid rubbing and avoid contact lenses

name: Eye strain
about: Tired, dry eyes from long phone or computer use.
homeCare: Follow the 20-20-20 rule: every 20 minutes look 20 feet away for 20 seconds
Blink often, adjust screen brightness
Get your eyes tested once a year

name: Ear infection
about: Pain and sometimes discharge, common after colds or swimming.
homeCare: Keep the ear dry
Do not put oil, drops or buds in the ear
Warm compress outside the ear
seeDoctorIf: Child pulling at ear with fever

name: Toothache / cavity
about: Pain from a cavity, infection or gum disease.
homeCare: Rinse with warm salt water
Brush twice a day and floss
Avoid very hot, cold or sweet food
seeDoctorIf: Swelling of the face or jaw

name: Acne
about: Blocked skin pores, common in teens and adults, often linked with oil, stress and hormones.
homeCare: Wash face twice a day with a mild cleanser
Do not squeeze pimples
Avoid heavy oily creams

name: Fungal infection / ringworm
about: Itchy, ring-shaped red patches, worse in sweaty folds of the skin and in humid weather.
homeCare: Keep skin clean and dry
Wear loose cotton clothes
Do not share towels; avoid steroid creams unless a doctor prescribes them

name: Eczema / dermatitis
about: Dry, itchy, inflamed skin that comes and goes.
homeCare: Moisturise right after bath
Use mild soap, avoid hot water
Wear soft cotton

name: Hair fall
about: Often linked to stress, low iron, thyroid problems or poor diet.
homeCare: Protein-rich food and enough iron
Gentle hair care, avoid tight styles
Manage stress and sleep

name: Back strain
about: Usually from posture, lifting or long sitting. Most cases improve in 1–2 weeks.
homeCare: Stay gently active — long bed rest makes it worse
Hot or cold pack for 15 minutes
Fix your sitting posture
seeDoctorIf: Pain going down the leg with numbness
Loss of bladder or bowel control — emergency
Pain after a fall or injury

name: Neck / shoulder strain
about: Stiffness from phone, laptop or bad sleeping position.
homeCare: Raise screens to eye level
Gentle neck and shoulder stretches
Use a thin pillow

name: Joint pain / arthritis
about: Pain and stiffness of joints, especially knees, hands and hips.
homeCare: Keep moving with gentle exercise
Maintain a healthy weight
Warm compress for stiffness

name: Muscle or ankle sprain
about: Stretched ligaments or muscles after a twist or fall.
homeCare: Rest, ice for 15 minutes, light compression, raise the limb
Avoid heavy use for a few days

name: Anaemia (low blood)
about: Low haemoglobin, often from low iron. Common in women and teens.
homeCare: Eat iron-rich foods: leafy greens, jaggery, dates, lentils, with a source of vitamin C
Get a blood test (CBC) before taking any supplements

name: Possible high blood sugar
about: These signs can mean high blood sugar. Only a blood test can confirm.
homeCare: Get a fasting sugar and HbA1c test
Cut sugary drinks; walk daily
seeDoctorIf: Very high thirst with vomiting or confusion — go to hospital

name: Low blood pressure / dehydration
about: Dizziness on standing, often from dehydration, skipped meals or heat.
homeCare: Drink water with a pinch of salt and sugar (ORS)
Rise slowly from lying down
Do not skip meals
seeDoctorIf: Dizziness with chest pain or palpitations

name: Anxiety / stress
about: Constant worry, restlessness, racing heart or poor sleep.
homeCare: Slow breathing: in for 4 counts, out for 6, for 5 minutes
Regular sleep and walks, less caffeine
Talk to someone you trust
seeDoctorIf: Thoughts of self-harm — call Tele-MANAS 14416 or 112 now

name: Poor sleep
about: Trouble falling or staying asleep.
homeCare: Fixed sleep and wake time
No phone for 1 hour before bed
Avoid tea or coffee after 4 pm

name: Period cramps
about: Lower belly pain before or during periods.
homeCare: Hot-water bag on the lower belly
Light walking and stretching
Warm drinks
seeDoctorIf: Pain stops you from daily life

name: Jaundice
about: Yellow skin or eyes from liver or bile problems. Needs a liver test.
homeCare: Rest, drink water, eat light food
Avoid alcohol and oily food; do not take herbal remedies blindly
seeDoctorIf: See a doctor the same day — jaundice always needs a test
